name: Texas HOSA Future Health Professionals
what_you_do: Join a HOSA chapter at your school to explore health careers. Texas HOSA runs a state leadership conference each year. Membership comes through school chapters.
grades: Middle school grades 6 to 8, and high school (secondary) students
who_can_apply: Secondary students in a state-approved Health Science program, or who plan a career in the health professions. Middle school students in grades 6 to 8 who like a health career path can also join. Membership goes through affiliated school chapters.
pay_detail: There are membership fees, but the amounts are not on the pages read. The site links to a 2026 to 2027 fee schedule.
deadline_text: No membership deadlines or conference dates are on the pages read. Ask your advisor for dates.
how_to_apply: Ask your school's health science teacher or chapter advisor about joining the chapter. State office: texashosa@texashosa.org or 1-877-728-0150.
notes: State office: 201 W. Hillside Road Suite 26, Laredo, TX 78041. Ask your advisor for the fee amount and conference dates.
